_help: Kitbash settings. Edit, save, reload the page. Delete a key (or the whole file) to get the built-in default back. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

level._help: start: null = the level the user picked last time; 1, 2, 3 or "demo" = always start there (a ?level= in the URL still wins).

scene._help: background: CSS colour of the background (e.g. "#d3d3d3"); null = the built-in dark one. On a light background the bench's lines and words turn dark.

stage._help: A banner at the top naming which part of a study this is (e.g. a test, then the real task); null = none. While the tutorial runs it says TUTORIAL.

errors._help: enabled: null = keep the toolbar Errors switch as the user left it; false = no wrong-part / wrong-hole / not-aligned messages, toasts or events (Level 3 no longer undoes such moves); true = force them on.

level3._help: Arrow keys: on a hole, left / right turn about the hole axis (rotateStepDeg, Shift rotateFineDeg) and up / down slide along it; a part not on a hole turns about the vertical (yawStepDeg, Shift yawShiftDeg). autoSnap: a part put down within snapPosMm and snapAngDeg of its place snaps onto it (keep snapAngDeg at least half the turn step so a turn always lands within reach).

flight._help: speed: Level 1 / 2 'moves into place by itself' flight speed (2 = twice as fast).

checks._help: A part counts as in place within posTolMm and angTolDeg of its reference pose. workspaceOnly: true = only what is built inside the assembly workspace counts (the base must be moved there first); false = an assembly counts wherever it is built.

collision._help: depthTolMm: interpenetration deeper than this is reported as a collision.

camera._help: autoView: Level 1 / 2 camera turns to the next part by itself.

ui._help: true = shown, false = hidden. debugButton: null = the Steps jump list only with ?debugSteps=1; true / false = always shown / hidden. nameTags: part names in the scene, 'off' | 'selected' (the clicked part) | 'step' (tray + clicked) | 'all'.

hints._help: What the bench shows by itself; false = not shown. A host's explicit marks still show. nextPart: arrow + glow on the part the step needs (in the tutorial too). placed: installed parts tinted, the flash when one goes in right, the ring where it seats. workspaceText: 'Move the base here before connecting parts'. ghost: see-through copies of parts where they go (step guide, answer playback). collision: parts that run into each other while moving turn red.

tutorial._help: autoStart: embedded in a host page, run the tutorial first; when it ends (done or skipped) the host's scene is laid out and the assembly starts. Practice is not reported to the host.

demo._help: Demo mode defaults. autoplay: false = wait for Next at every unit. by: part | substep | step (what one Next plays). speed: multiplier. gap / substepGap / stepGap: pauses in ms. trajectory: approach | direct | answer (recorded path). camera: follow | fixed. from / to: step numbers (1-based) or step ids, null = whole build. steps: e.g. [1, 3, 5] or null. fresh: start from a full kit. loop: start over when done. restore: put the scene back on exit. hideTray: hide the tray. bar: show the playback bar.

text._help: Words about the product being built; the bench itself only knows parts. assembled: celebration headline. demoDone: demo bar after the last step.
